item.title: Caricatures Of Tony Soprano Inspire A Wave Of AI-Generated 'Gabagool' Memes On TikTok, Reels
item.description: The Gabagool Meme or the AI Gabagool Guy is a series of AI-generated videos where caricatures of Tony Soprano, meant to represent a stereotypical Italian-American man, discuss and talks about gabagool, an Italian-American slang term for the cured pork delicacy capicola. The memes, which typically use Sora AI, were popularized on TikTok and Instagram Reels in late January 2026.

item.title: TikTok Comment Meme 'Who Is This?' Comes From Obscure Album Artwork
item.description: Who Is This? is a reaction image and TikTok sticker meme depicting two black men against a teal background above the text "WHO IS THIS?" The meme comes from album artwork for a song titled "Who us this?" by Afro gospel artist Louis Pascal, featuring Edem Evangelist, which was originally released in 2022. item.title: Satirical Headline From 2020 'The Hard News' Article About The Tragic Fate Of A Chimpanzee Becomes A Meme
item.description: We Taught This Chimpanzee and He Hanged Himself is an exploitable meme format based on a story by the satirical news site The Hard Times titled, "We Taught This Chimpanzee to Understand the American Political System and He Hanged Himself." The article was published in October 2020 and spread online over the following years. In 2025, the article's thumbnail became the increasing subject of edits and redraws, in which the caption and the chimpanzee are replaced to reference another subject.

item.title: Image Of Tiny Puppy With The Warning 'Will Bite' Inspires Redraws Online
item.description: "Will Bite" Dog refers to a video of a small white dog or puppy in an animal shelter behind a glass door with a red sign displaying "will bite" in white letters. The original video was later screenshot and cropped for use in memes, gaining virality in October 2025 after it became a meme as the subject of redraws in which artists swapped various pop culture characters for the dog pouting in the cage. Some memes also changed the wording on the sign.
